name: asterius-ai-blackbox
description: Chat with an AI agent that builds your application in Azure DevOps and deploys test environments to Kubernetes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
